info.name: Get historical positions of an account of a client, that were closed within the specified period

params.name: $inlinecount
params.description: Specifies that the response to the request should include a count of the number of entries in the collection

params.name: $skip
params.description: The number of entries to skip from the beginning of the collection

params.name: $skiptoken
params.description: Specifies an entity id to start retrieving entries from. This is normally only used in generated nextlinks.

params.name: $top
params.description: The number of entries to return from the beginning of the collection

params.name: AccountGroupKey
params.description: Id of the account containing the historical positions.

params.name: AccountKey
params.description: Id of the account containing the historical positions.

params.name: AssetType
params.description: Filtering on asset type. If value not supplied all will be returned

params.name: ClientKey
params.description: Id of the client owning the account

params.name: FromDate
params.description: From date from which the historical positions are requested.

params.name: ToDate
params.description: To date till which the historical positions are requested.

items.docs:
Returns a list of historical positions for a specific account owned by a client.
             The required fields are ClientKey and either StandardPeriod or FromDate/ToDate.
